title: apocalypticrpg
description: A zombie apocalypse server by solo dev.
body:
Hey, you.. Yes you... Welcome to ApocalpticRPG... It is a zombie apocalypse server and it is inspired by modpacks... It is made as a passion project by a solo dev..  This is an remake as the old server got yetted.

Features: 
- Custom Textures
- Random Lootcrate
- Bone Breaking
- Infection
- Melee Weapans
- Guns
- Craft GUI
- Scrap Mechanic
- And more

Besure to check us out. We support 1.21.11+ but their maybe problems in resourcepack from 1.21.5 downwards. The developer is still working on the server as this is beta testing only.
